name: Combos (parlay) RFQ market making
one_line: Quote 2-50 leg sports parlays in 400 ms RFQ auctions (200 ms on the US venue), earn the parlay premium, hedge legs on the CLOB and graduate to Last Look.
scope: Cover the RFQ sequence (400 ms quote window, 10 s acceptance, 1 s last look; US: 200 ms / 3 s / 1 s delay), onboarding and Last Look eligibility (~$2,500 notional, 15% rejection cap), collateral vs inventory sourcing, Positions Framework, Collateral Return, leg universe (sports moneyline/spread/total), correlation pricing and same-game blow-up risk, Kalshi evidence that parlays are overpriced ~3% per leg (1.22x at 10 legs) and combos at 36% of contracts, early Polymarket US beta volumes, unpublished combo fees, reported in-house Polymarket desk. raw_discovery_candidates.name: Parlay / combo underwriting (RFQ responder) against calibrated legs
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Multi-leg parlays are overpriced by ~3% per leg even when each leg is perfectly calibrated; respond to parlay RFQs and hedge with the single-leg books.
raw_discovery_candidates.maturity: Emerging (documented on Kalshi; Polymarket availability unverified)
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Price each requested parlay as the product of leg mids (adjusted for cross-game correlation, which is ~0 for different games), quote the customer at the prevailing inflated market level, and optionally lay off legs in the single-game CLOBs. Median overpricing is nil for 2-4 legs, 3.7% at 7 legs, 22% at 10 legs, 30.5% at 11 legs. Kalshi now instantiates ~1.09M on-demand combo tickers per day, so the flow is large.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Lottery demand for high-multiplier tickets; customers cannot easily compare to the fair product of legs.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Sportsbook-style margin inside an exchange wrapper, with transparent hedging instruments on the same venue.

evidence.title: Prices, Probabilities, and Parlays: Systematic Bias in Sports Prediction Markets (Moshrefi), arXiv
evidence.supports: 12,639 cross-game parlay trades (Mar-May 2026, Kalshi): median overpricing ratio ~1.00 for 2-4 legs, 1.005 (5), 1.037 (7), 1.223 (10), 1.305 (11); per-leg inflation ~3% (beta 0.029, R2 0.94) while single legs 30-240 min from expiry are calibrated.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Correlated legs (same game) break the product rule; tail payouts are lumpy - bankroll must survive an 11-leg hit; RFQ access and venue eligibility; whether Polymarket offers an equivalent product is unverified.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Pull Kalshi combo trade prints for a month, compute realised PnL of a hypothetical responder pricing at the traded price and hedging nothing vs hedging legs.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Kalshi is a US CFTC venue; access/eligibility constraints. Polymarket equivalent: unverified.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Combo (parlay) RFQ market making
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Quote multi-leg Combo requests within 400 ms and earn the parlay premium retail pays.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Combos are 2-10 leg contracts paying $1 only if all legs hit; they do not trade on the CLOB but through request-for-quote. Approved makers receive each request, must answer within a 400 ms window with a price per YES Combo share, and can fill from collateral (taking the NO side at 1 - price) or inventory. Makers with about $2,500 of Combo notional get Last Look but are paused if they reject more than 15% of selected quotes in an hour. Pricing edge comes from leg correlation and from hedging legs on the CLOB. Launched offshore 2026-06-10; Polymarket US API-only beta from 2026-08-05.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Retail demand for long-shot multi-leg payouts; few approved quoters; correlation modelling.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Same structure that earns sportsbooks their highest hold; Kalshi's parallel product did $13.78B in July 2026 and $25M taker fees in 16 days, while Polymarket's is weeks old with a short maker list. A newspaper headline says retail is losing big on combos while sophisticated traders profit (body paywalled, unverified).

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Combos (parlay) RFQ quoting
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Become a quoter on Polymarket's new multi-leg RFQ. Price correlated parlays for retail and hedge the legs on the CLOB. This is the sportsbook's highest-margin product with optional last look.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: A requester sends an unsigned Combo request of 2-50 legs. Makers have 400 ms to return signed quotes in pUSD per YES share. The best quote goes to the user, who has 10 s to accept. Makers with Last Look then have 1 s to accept or reject. Last Look needs about $2.5k of combo notional and a relationship with Polymarket, and rejecting more than 15% in an hour gets you paused. The maker fills by minting and buying NO at 1 minus the price, or from inventory. The job is to price joint probabilities, because correlation is where retail misprices. Add a markup, then hedge the legs on the CLOB.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Retail demand for longshot parlays, plus pricing power over correlation. Parlays on Kalshi trade above the product of their leg prices, and the gap grows with the number of legs.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Few quoters have the infrastructure yet. The product is new and its docs carry no listed launch date. A 400 ms window rewards engineering, not balance sheet. Last look caps toxic fills. On Kalshi, combos were already 36% of contracts by July 2026.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Sportsbook same-game-parlay pricing, and last-look RFQ market making in bonds, ETFs and FX. Automated parlay market makers: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22596 and https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18299

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Correlated legs mispriced as independent is the classic same-game-parlay blow-up. Collateral is locked until the last leg resolves. Informed requesters pick off stale leg prices inside 400 ms. Rejecting too often gets you paused. Combo fees and Polymarket's volumes are unverified.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Connect to the RFQ websocket read-only. Log requests and winning quotes against the product of CLOB leg mids for 2 weeks, which gives the realised markup and the request flow in dollars per day before you commit collateral.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: None identified. Check whether combo-enabled markets are geo-restricted, which is unverified.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Combos (parlay) RFQ market making
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Become a quoter in the new multi-leg Combos RFQ auctions: price 2-50 sports legs within a 400 ms window (200 ms on the US venue), win recreational parlay flow, and graduate to Last Look.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: A requester sends an unsigned RFQ for a conjunction of outcomes (currently sports moneyline, spread and total legs); connected makers submit signed quotes within 400 ms, the best quote is shown, the user has 10 s to accept, and makers with Last Look get 1 s to confirm. Last Look is granted to makers with about $2,500 of combo notional and a line of communication with Polymarket; rejecting more than 15% of selected quotes in an hour gets a maker paused. Quotes are funded from pUSD or from inventory; combo YES/NO are fully collateralised ERC-1155 positions on a new Positions Framework, can be split/merged, compress as legs resolve, and a Collateral Return plan releases pUSD from offsetting combos before resolution. Polymarket US runs the same product for institutional participants: 200 ms quote window, 3 s last look, 1 s delay before paired order submission, 1,000 new combos per user per week, void legs settle at Last Fair Market Price. Hedge legs on the CLOB.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Risk premium and correlation pricing on flow that is overwhelmingly recreational; few quoting engines exist yet; last look is a free option against stale-leg sniping.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Parlay pricing is the highest-margin product in sports betting and here legs can be hedged on a liquid CLOB; early quoters compete against a handful of firms rather than the full LP crowd.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Correlated same-game legs mispriced as independent get picked off by sharp requesters; capital locked until the last leg resolves (partly fixed by Collateral Return); 400/200 ms deadlines demand colocated infrastructure; fee treatment for combos is unpublished; Last Look can be withdrawn.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Connect as a maker in listen-only mode and log the RFQ stream for two weeks: leg mix, requested size, and (from fills) the winning price versus the product of leg mids; this yields the realised parlay margin before writing a pricer.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Last Look requires an application and relationship with Polymarket; US venue requires institutional onboarding.
